examples.ar: اليَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي.
examples.en: Today I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you.

examples.ar: اليَدُ العُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ اليَدِ السُّفْلَى.
examples.en: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.

examples.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا * إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا.
examples.en: For indeed, with hardship [there is] ease. Indeed, with hardship [there is] ease.
And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty.

examples.ar: العِلْمُ يَنْبُوعٌ لَا يَنْضَبُ عَبْرَ العُصُورِ.
examples.en: Knowledge is a fountain that does not run dry across ages.
